evidence.note: The Authentication record declares an Aad block with AuthorizationUri and Resource. The code declares no oauth kind, so no OAuth sub-questions apply.
Data is requested with Web.Contents against the Azure Resource Manager Resource Graph endpoint.
The subscription parameter names a resource inside the tenant, so it counts as database-or-resource-id.
The managementGroup parameter names a resource inside the tenant, so it counts as database-or-resource-id.
The optional options record holds connector settings, which is options-record.
The required query parameter is free-form KQL text. It is not a URL, region, or date range, so it is recorded as other.

options-fields.text: The options record accepts one field, resultTruncated (logical, allowed values true and false). When it is absent, it defaults to true, which fetches a single page capped at 1000 rows.

evidence.note: Declares the resultTruncated field inside the options record.
resultTruncated is true when options[resultTruncated] is null.
When resultTruncated is true, the request sets $skip = 0 and $top = 1000.
The next page token is read from the SkipToken metadata of the previous page.
Reads the $skipToken field from the response body.
Pages are produced by Table.GenerateByPage.
The connector defines its own Table.GenerateByPage helper. It is built on List.Generate, which is not counted as list-generate.

paging-stop.text: Paging stops when the response has no $skipToken, which GetSkipToken returns as null. With the default resultTruncated = true, nextSkipToken is forced to null, so only one page of up to 1000 rows is fetched. ARGImpl requests the next page only while the previous page's SkipToken metadata is not null.

evidence.note: nextSkipToken is null when resultTruncated is true; otherwise it comes from the response body.
Returns null when $skipToken is absent.
The next page is requested only when nextToken is not null.
The response body is parsed with Json.Document.
Column names come from the first record's field names through Record.FieldNames, and no M column types are declared.
The table type is taken from Value.Type of the data itself, so the connector assigns no declared types.
ManualStatusHandling = {500, 400} is set on the only live Web.Contents call.
The status is inspected manually: 500 is retried, and 400 returns an error result.
A failed request is sent again after a delay through Value.WaitFor.

retry-rule.text: Only HTTP 500 is retried. HTTP 400 returns an error result immediately, and other statuses are returned as results without retry. Value.WaitFor is called with count 3, so the retry loop makes at most three attempts. The delay is 2^iteration seconds (1, 2, 4 s), and IsRetry = iteration > 0. A 500 response returns null while iteration < 3. The error-result branch for iteration >= 3 cannot be reached with count 3.

evidence.note: IsRetry is set to iteration > 0 on each request.
500 is retried while iteration < 3; 400 returns an error result.
The interval is #duration(0,0,0,Number.Power(2, iteration)) with count 3.
Documentation.Name, LongDescription, and Examples are set on the function type.
Documentation.FieldCaption and FieldDescription are set on the query parameter.
Documentation.SampleValues is set on the query parameter.
Documentation.AllowedValues lists Tenant, Subscription, and Management group for scope.
The shared function returns one table directly, with no navigation table.
TestConnection returns the AzureResourceGraph.Query entry function with the query 'resources | limit 1'.
The connector is a single .pq file with no pqm modules.
Strings are loaded through Extension.LoadString.
Icons are loaded through Extension.Contents.
